ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 80 percent of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the median notch, trailing edge, and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs forming the lateral lobes. A central, low-intensity black region forms a bifurcated wedge shape originating at the median notch. Irregular black pixel banding follows the entire trailing edge contour.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior angle estimated at 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most extreme at the distal tips where boundary definition is interrupted by clustered textures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in distinct, upward-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of irregular pixels at both distal tips, creating significant protrusion from the primary edge topography.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular pixel clusters at the outer edges of both lobes, consistent with significant barnacle colonization or localized trauma resulting in secondary growth.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation displays a 'dripping' effect where the low-intensity pixels extend irregularly into the high-intensity white regions of the inner lobes.
